notes.title: DeliSpace Public Release
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/0e27e1948c90d2902d501f854ce242cfa878f23a.png

hires from 30.08.2024 7AM CEST!
Do you have what it takes to become the best courier in the universe?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/df14c6a35ad488b6ee8968ce1dd3603c11400310.gif
Job requirements
To apply for a job you will need a suitable interface that facilitates the connection to your ship:
- Windows 32/64 bit PC
- OSX (Mac) with Intel or Apple Silicone processor
A one time application fee of $9.99 (or equivalent in your currency) is necessary. If you are unsure we highly recommend our free demonstrational app that simulates the realities of space courier experience with 94%* accuracy.

From 8th of September 2024 we will additionally support a portable Nintendo Switch interface (please mind a slightly higher application fee of $14.99)

NO SPACESHIP DRIVING LICENSE REQUIRED! We cover your pilot exam during onboarding with our simulated environment: T.U.T.O.R.I.A.L.

Job description
We offer a job in ever changing environment. Working 10 hours every day of the week? Not here. We feature a shift based approach: split your job in short shifts consisting of 5 missions that you can complete within minutes and work when you have time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/8444566968910ec02287a108cfc9c1ede2702345.gif

Your responsibilities include:
- delivering packages between various planets in 13 star systems,
- maintaining and upgrading your ship,
- choosing appropriate load-out to adapt for challenges of each world,
- mastering 9 different package types, and their effect on your ship,
- minimising damage to the shipped goods and the hull of your ship by avoiding obstacles (including but not limited to: asteroids, meteor showers, space debris, etc.) and navigating under influence of: time-space continuum altering entities (including but not limited to: black holes, time crystals, etc.) as well as any other physics-based phenomena (including but not limited to: pulsars, nebulas, etc.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/e5c66d549b72ad318c6c3d3fff0420f29711bd57.png

What we offer?
- opportunities to expand your pilot license with 5 additional license exams,
- friendly, competitive environment for comparing your performance with other pilots with speedrun mode in the exams,
- flat rate payout that can be used to buy upgrades and unlock new worlds (see. payout table in Appendix A)
- accessible bonus system based on collecting mail that increases your payout,
- motivational awards system based on your achievements
- an official certificate signed by the CEO of HexyArts Corp, granted upon establishing maximum reputation with all planets using our services.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/7d93994164ee00610992c98c6436d9e44bb8f38d.png


*not confirmed with any actual research

notes.title: v. 1.0.1 Prerelease fixes
notes.content:
Hi! 
The biggest announcement is: Apple Silicon is now supported!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/fe60f54e97380418839a1c1901e1b086963a9bcc.png
If your game pad for whatever reason identifies itself in ambiguous manner or disguises itself as a "Win 360 Controller" you can now force a button scheme from the main menu.

 Changelog 
Added
- Tab opens map too (in addition to the M button)
- Apple Silicon support

Changed
- 3 seconds cooldown after flying out of signalled zone
- Reduced the speed penalty in the no-signal zone
- Switched buttons on controllers so that X is confirm and B is cancel
- No Signal prompt is no longer blinking and does not obscure the ship
- "Immortality"/protection after hitting an obstacle changed from 0.5s to 1s

Fixed
- Some buttons not updating button hint after changing controller type
- Cases where ship was carrying some momentum over the respawn after being rescued
- Corrected the selection button in main menu (introduced previously in full version)

notes.title: v. 1.0.0 The final demo
notes.content:
Hi! 
It's done. The content for the full game is ready. There will be:
- 18 Unique worlds, each posing a different challenge
- 29 Perks that can be unlocked by ingame currency
- 9 package types - each has an impact on your ship and game difficulty. Not impressed? That's 189* different package configurations!
- 11 achievements pushing you to explore and interact with the world
- 5 repetitive (as: non random) speedrunning levels with timer and score tracking

The final version is ready. I would love to release at the end of August, but I want to have a simultaneous release here and on Switch so the final date depends on Nintendo.
The full version will be available for Youtubers until then.

As for the demo release v 1.0.0.44 it does not bring anything new, but a ton of bugfixes, graphical improvements, and a rebalance that matches the final version.

 Changelog 
Added
- (Tutorial) Explanation that rescuing costs reputation
- Some asteroids in tutorial to enforce some manoeuvring
- Sounds to Rescue Ship

Changed
- It is now possible to sell perks
- Reward for collecting all mail: 2 coins (was 1)
- Completing exam gives one coin
- Economy rebalanced
- Color scheme of (un)discovered worlds
- Hazard ratings
- No more free starting coins
- Nicer stars in rating displays
- Nebula disrupts signal
- Package adds a little weight to the ship physics
- Optimised Mine level
- Normal License costs coins

Removed
- Unused key map from tutorial control list
- Placeholder name from Rescue Ship in Tutorial

Fixed
- Perk and World counting achievements not updating
- Career Progress updates when data changes
- Loadout messing galaxy map navigation
- Collectibles picked from Mine being registered as from Alpha
- Exams getting stuck when not first to start
- Multiple package modificators can be now applied
- Correct amount of mail in Career Progress
- Displaying correct amount of collected coins per world
- Better fitting colliders in Mine level

*If you checked and think I'm wrong, I'm not. It is not 512 because some package combinations are mutually exclusive.

notes.title: v. 0.7.0 Flying with the big boys
notes.content:
Hi! 
It's been some time but I wast mostly working on the new content for the full version. 
I can confirm the full version will feature 18 LEVELS
The perk number is growing, and sits currently at 30 and I'm not done yet. Have any suggestions? Go on! Now for the update...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/eb82b4fac52e22c11e7223e614311b0dba2a73c8.png
You can now leave the designated zone. But only for 5 seconds (and since the signal is very weak, expect a low control response).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/8d48ac7b7280f309b14bfca747e451aec817ff57.gif
Once you stayed too long, the rescue ship will collect you (this will damage your reputation with the nearest planet that dispatches the ship!).

QoL - or prettyfying in this case (I can't help it - I just like experimenting too much). A nicer tooltip - now with the animated pictogram.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/d0df973ab4f292106b145d23d0f7122eae83d96c.gif

 Changelog 
Added
- Slight gravity to HUB to hold ship in center
- Parenthesis to the font
- Shuttle that takes away disabled ship
- 8 new levels (available in full version!)
- 3 new planets (available in full version!)
- 6 new perks (available in full version!)
- Implemented all achievements (available in full version!)

Updated
- Graphics optimisations
- Code optimisations

Changed
- Leaving game area causes failure and ship redeployment
- Galaxy map layout to display bigger perk icons

Fixed
- Lava planet glow
- Ship stuck at last input when control is cut off
- Galaxy map not setting pointer on init
- Replicator trait (was same as reroll)

notes.title: v. 0.6.2 NextFest Hotfix
notes.content:
Thank's a lot for the help with pinpointing the controller issues. 
It's the smallest update yet but probably the most important.
Have fun flying!

notes.title: v. 0.6.1 Are we there yet?
notes.content:
Wonder if you're already the best courier in the universe? There's now a clear visualisation to your career progress!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/a66033a1276ed2fb517da54a90887cd11d5834a7.gif

Radar shows collectibles!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/82a1c3c130a59d51f9970ed29d2683e53a1c39f5.gif

Some say levels are too easy, some say levels are too hard. Remember not to judge difficulty of the whole game by its first (easier) level. A hazard property is now displayed for each world to hint at how dangerous/hard it is to fly there. Also: font now has proper slashes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/f921a3a53e2a0d02b87cc474a5ae0cc4e871f161.png

Wonder which type of perk can be used as a loadout? Well, now it should be obvious: the passive ones. Mind the color sheme is now different.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/6284d7e98e866e09b60705086fc115b47fd0980b.png

 Changelog 
Added
- Displaying achievement unlock progress in main menu
- Proper slashes to the font
- Career progression in Galaxy View
- Hazard (difficulty) rating for each world
- Radar shows collectibles

Changed
- Renamed planet T8-IGHT+RRA to TR4-PIST
- Swapped perks color scheme

Updated
- Widith of certain font characters (easier reading, nicer look)

Fixed
- Summary graphic in tutorial
- Game not starting if Steam is not running
- Menu opening after choosing a destination

notes.title: v. 0.5.1 Ready for a challenge?
notes.content:
The most notable change is addition of Steam API: Stats & Achievements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/9fe3ed4115fc2e46bfaa9f20b2155e984023505c.gif


The demo comes equipped with 3 achievements just to get a handle on the UI. The gallery can be accessed from the main menu:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/2500034ec9afd4cf81d6c6eef469d987d2f60357.png

The full version will have at least 14 Achievements of varying challenge level. Some will be stat based.

The nicest QoL change is display of signal sources. It got optimized, crisper graphics and does not require any additional input. The zones are now displayed when ship gets close to the boundary.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/f809ea6a3455187ac517bea55920bdb481d07ecd.gif

 Changelog 
Added
- Achievements gallery
- Few demo achievements

Changed
- Made asteroid belt a little wider
- Showing out of signal zone when near it
- Less noise near "no signal" zones

Removed
- Pinging

Fixed
- Discord invite
- More detailed asteroid collision boxes
- No packages overlapping in exams

notes.title: v. 0.5 Take it easy!
notes.content:
The most notable difference is a whole new level!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/cc14c327e0fe8faf7a1f88310ad3adbd200e1a4c.png
Let's start simple, with fewer obstacles and less gravity. Your first assignment is to make deliveries on an asteroid mining site!

Also, you will start with a self healing package (with a slightly longer heal time of course), but still the first steps you'll take won't be as punishing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/63af017ed5ea686de005bc67e7794cff19a5863e.gif


 Changelog 
Added
- Self healing package type
- New level (first, much easier one)

Changed
- Displaying only relevant pickup and dropoff zones
- Improved contrast of planetoids
- Limited the scope of the demo
- Normal package license can be bought whenever ready

Updated
- Performance optimizations

Fixed
- Exams can be taken once discovered
